title: How Chinese manufacturers are dominating the humanoid robot supply chain, even as the industry struggles to find a purpose for such robots (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: How Chinese manufacturers are dominating the humanoid robot supply chain, even as the industry struggles to find a purpose for such robots — China's lead in humanoid robots was evident at last month's Humanoids Summit, a robotics conference in Tokyo.Videos by Qilai Shen and Hiroko Masuike
